subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Twin-Twin Transfusion, TRAP, Conjoined and Locked Twins

steps.tx: Unbalanced blood sharing through placental vessel connections in monochorionic twins causes **twin-twin transfusion syndrome**. The donor twin shrinks with no fluid while the recipient overloads with excess fluid and heart strain. It complicates about one in ten monochorionic pregnancies. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Twin-twin transfusion unbalances blood sharing, shrinking the donor and overloading the recipient.

steps.tx: Fetoscopic laser sealing of the connecting placental vessels is **laser ablation** for transfusion syndrome. Performed at sixteen to twenty six weeks in specialist centres, it treats the cause directly. Survival of at least one twin reaches eighty percent in modern series. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Laser ablation seals connecting vessels and saves at least one twin in eighty percent.

steps.tx: One twin pumping blood to a headless, heartless partner through reversed flow is the **TRAP sequence**. Twin reversed arterial perfusion burdens the normal pumps heart with both circulations. Occluding the abnormal twins cord saves the pump twin. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: TRAP sequence burdens the normal twin pumping for a heartless partner.

steps.tx: Twins joined at chest, abdomen or head from very late splitting are **conjoined twins**. Prognosis depends on shared organs, especially heart and liver. Multidisciplinary planning from diagnosis decides separability and timing. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Conjoined twins join at chest or abdomen and prognosis depends on shared organs.

steps.tx: Interlocking where the first breech twins head is trapped by the second twins descending head is **locked twins**. It is rare and usually involves a breech first twin with vertex second. Emergency manoeuvres or caesarean resolve the impaction. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Locked twins interlock breech and vertex heads, usually needing emergency caesarean.

steps.tx: Weight difference over twenty percent between twins defines **discordant growth**. It may reflect transfusion imbalance or one twins placental insufficiency. The smaller twins Doppler studies drive delivery timing. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Discordant growth over twenty percent needs Doppler driven delivery timing for the smaller twin.

steps.tx: The old rule that twinning frequency follows one in eighty to the power of litter size is **Hellin law**. It predicted triplets at one in eighty squared historically. Assisted conception has broken its assumptions in modern practice. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Hellin law predicted multiples by powers of eighty before assisted conception changed rates.

steps.tx: Quintero staging grades transfusion syndrome by fluid, bladder, Doppler and hydrops findings, termed **Quintero staging**. Stage guides urgency of laser referral. Rapid progression can occur between fortnightly scans. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Quintero staging grades transfusion severity and guides laser referral urgency.

steps.tx: Selective growth restriction in monochorionic twins without transfusion is managed by **Doppler based timing**. Umbilical waveforms classify the pattern and its risks. Delivery balances the restricted twins danger against prematurity for both. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Selective growth restriction uses Doppler patterns to time delivery for both twins.
